item.title: Spain Win the 2026 World Cup
item.description: Spain beat Argentina in the final in New Jersey, sealing it with an extra-time goal in the 106th minute. Argentina failed a single shot on target across 120 minutes.

item.title: AusAlert National Test - Mon 27 July
item.description: Every phone in Australia will sound for a nationwide AusAlert test. Critical alerts can override silent mode, so plan ahead if a concealed safety phone is at risk.

item.title: Executive Quarterly Strategy - Wed 22 July
item.description: The Executive Quarterly Strategy session takes place on Wednesday 22 July.

item.title: Lunch & Learn: Change at LeavePlus - Wed 22 July 10am
item.description: Session in L5 breakout at 10am covering what change management is, the LeavePlus Change Framework, and a preview of the Change Management Toolkit. All welcome, in person or Teams.

item.title: Last Lunchtime Pilates - Wed 22 July
item.description: The final lunchtime Pilates session with Lan Tran is on Wednesday 22 July. Spaces are still available, so book your spot and keep moving this July.

item.title: Security Passes Must Be Carried On Site
item.description: Following a building access audit, always carry your assigned pass on site. Spare passes are emergency once-offs only. Report a lost pass immediately so it can be deactivated.

item.title: ISO/IEC 27001 Stage 2 Audit - All Week
item.description: The Stage 2 certification audit starts today and runs all week. Keep desks clear, secure belongings, and lock your screen whenever you step away.

item.title: EOI: Present the Acknowledgement of Country
item.description: Interested in presenting the Acknowledgement of Country at a Town Hall? Sign up to take part. Your voice and presence can make the moment meaningful for everyone.

item.title: Footy Tipping - AFL Round 19
item.description: Round 19 delivered some coin-toss results, with Collingwood edging Carlton. Tilly still holds a slim 1-point lead over the tipping field, for now.

item.title: Food Storage - Clear Out the L5 Fridges
item.description: Expired and mouldy items are being found and discarded in the L5 fridges. Please keep an eye on your perishables and throw out anything past its date.

item.title: Ground Floor Meeting Room Set-Up Notice
item.description: Booked a Ground Floor room and need set-up help? Email Reception and Nathan Crick 24-48 hours ahead, and allow 30 minutes before your meeting to prepare.

item.title: Conflict of Interest Declaration Overdue
item.description: The annual Conflict of Interest declaration was due end June and only 60% of staff have completed it. Please check your email and action it. Queries: John Dalla Fontana or Doreen Su.

item.title: Welcome New Starter: Kuldeep Tyagi
item.description: Kuldeep Tyagi joined as Data Engineer in Data & Analytics on 13 July. Please join us in making Kuldeep feel welcome to LeavePlus.

item.title: Farewell: Oliver Liwanag
item.description: Oliver Liwanag, Marketing Lead, finished up on 15 July. We thank Oli for his contributions and wish him well in his future endeavours.

item.title: Farewell: Rory Bampton - Fri 24 July
item.description: Rory Bampton, Communications Lead, finishes up on 24 July. We thank Rory for his contributions and wish him well in his future endeavours.

item.title: Staff Movements
item.description: No internal staff movements this week.

item.title: Wellness Corner: Do Things You Enjoy
item.description: Reserve time each day for activities you enjoy, whether that's exercise, baking, crafting, reading or watching TV. It's an essential part of healthy living.

item.title: Now Hiring: Two Internal Roles Open
item.description: Two roles are advertised on the Team Tailor recruitment platform: Consultant - Service Investigations and Head of Product. Check them out if you're looking for a new role.
